name: ExtDosageCodedDirections
title: Coded directions (NHG Tabel 25 Gebruiksvoorschrift)
description: The NHG Tabel 25 coded usage instruction, verbatim, e.g. '3-4D1S; gedurende max. 1 maand'. FHIR models dosing structurally (Dosage.timing / Dosage.doseAndRate) and has no element for a compact coded string. HL7 NL registers OIDs only for individual Tabel 25 components — time units (2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.4.3) and additional texts (2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.4.5) — not for the composite string, and Nictiz's Medicatieproces 9 mp-InstructionsForUse profile has no slot for it either. This extension carries the string so no information is lost; it accompanies, and does not replace, the structured Dosage derived from it.
